title: Install and configure Vitest for unit testing
description: Install Vitest and configure it for TypeScript ESM unit testing. Create a vitest.config.ts pointing to test files in src/. Add a test script to package.json. Verify the test runner starts correctly with no test files.
acceptanceCriteria: vitest is installed as a devDependency
test script in package.json runs vitest
npm test exits 0 with a message indicating no test files found

steps.details: Run: `npm install --save-dev vitest`. Vitest includes its own type definitions.
Create vitest.config.ts at project root: import { defineConfig } from 'vitest/config'; export default defineConfig({ test: { include: ['src/**/*.test.ts'], environment: 'node' } })
Update scripts.test in package.json to: 'vitest run'. The run flag ensures tests exit after completion rather than watching for changes.
Run `npm test`. Should exit 0. With no test files, Vitest prints a message like 'No test files found'. If it errors on config, verify vitest.config.ts is valid TypeScript.

technicalNotes: Vitest natively supports TypeScript and ESM — no additional transform configuration needed for this project
Use 'vitest run' (not 'vitest') in package.json scripts to run tests once and exit (CI-friendly)
